newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Megawati's brother causes stir in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Megawati's brother causes stir in Indonesia.

text.p: The brother of ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri has caused a stir in Jakarta by appearing in public with senior members of Indonesia's ruling Golkar party, news reports said on Friday.

Musician Guruh Sukarnoputra, who is also a member of parliament for the opposition Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), was splashed across the front pages of various newspapers at the launch of an album as part of a government campaign against the designer drug Ecstasy.

The launch caused a stir in Indonesia due to the presence of a number of Golkar members, including Education and Culture Minister Wardiman Djojonegoro, Welfare Minister Azwar Anas and Youth and Sports Minister Hayono Isman.
The newspaper Media Indonesia quoted Guruh as saying the Golkar members who attended were simply "old friends".
But the Republika daily said the presence of such high-ranking figures had led to speculation that Guruh might be considering changing his political allegiance.
Guruh and Megawati are son and daughter of the country's late founding president Sukarno. Megawati was ousted as leader of the PDI by a government-backed party faction in June.
Political analysts have said the government moved to sideline Megawati from politics for fear she might draw votes from Golkar in next year's parliamentary elections.

Media Indonesia said that Guruh, who is primarily a choreographer, had denied speculation he would join Golkar. He was quoted as saying he wanted to concentrate on his music and dance rather than be embroiled in politics.
